intro: You get all the basic moves, plus two Covenant moves. Pick two of these:

moves.title: Get Down!
moves.descriptionHtml: When you protect someone, you may choose to split the harm suffered with a nearby ally as well as yourself and the protected person.

moves.title: Fast Friends
moves.descriptionHtml:
When you meet a new being and spend time befriending them, roll +Charm.
  • On a 10+, they become your ally.
  • On a 7–9, they become your ally until the end of the mystery.
  • On a miss, you’ve offended them.
You can only gain one permanent ally per mystery with this move (a second 10+ makes them an ally for the rest of the mystery).

moves.title: Smash Cut
moves.descriptionHtml:
Once per mystery, when you reveal you asked an ally to do something for you, describe the task as a flashback and roll +Cool.
  • On a 10+, it went off smoothly. The Keeper describes the results.
  • On a 7–9, it was either more dangerous or less effective than you hoped. The Keeper describes the results.
  • On a miss, your allies are in serious danger right now.

moves.title: The Geek in the Chair
moves.descriptionHtml: Your ally watches and guides you remotely. You may spend 1 hold from read a bad situation to warn someone about to suffer harm, pre- venting 2 harm. You gain +1 forward to read a bad situation in each new location.

moves.title: Acolyte
moves.descriptionHtml: Either one of your existing allies has acquired supernatural powers or you have acquired a supernatu- ral ally. You decide with the Keeper what sort of powers they have.

moves.title: Who Said I Was Alone?
moves.descriptionHtml: Once per session, when your ally suddenly appears, treat a miss result as if you rolled a 7–9. Immediate consequences (such as suffering harm) apply to you, but the ally becomes the focus of attention.

moves.title: Opening Doors
moves.descriptionHtml: Your allies have their own contacts and social circles. Once per session, an ally can arrange a meeting between you and someone they know. You have +1 ongoing to interact with your ally’s contacts during this meeting.
